question: What are your customer service hours?
answer: Our customer service representatives are available Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM Central. Outage reporting and the gas emergency line (1-800-555-0199) are available 24 hours a day.
title: Customer service hours

question: How do I report a streetlight that is out?
answer: Report a streetlight at cymbalenergy.example/streetlights with the pole number (on a metal tag about eye level) or the nearest address. Repairs are usually completed within 5 business days.
title: Streetlight repair

question: Where can I pay my bill in person?
answer: You can pay in person at any Cymbal Energy payment location, including our Pascagoula and Ocean Springs offices and participating grocery and pharmacy stores. A $1.50 convenience fee may apply at retail locations.
title: Payment locations

question: How do I start service at a new address?
answer: Start service online at cymbalenergy.example/start at least 3 business days before your move-in date. You will need a photo ID and the service address.
title: Start service

question: How do I stop service when I move out?
answer: Stop service online at cymbalenergy.example/stop or call 1-800-555-0142 at least 3 business days before you move. Your final bill is mailed to your forwarding address.
title: Stop service

question: Is there a deposit to start service?
answer: A deposit of up to $150 may be required for new customers without a recent payment history with Cymbal Energy. It is refunded after 12 months of on-time payments.
title: Deposits

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept bank draft, debit and credit cards through our secure payment page, checks by mail, and cash at payment locations. We never accept gift cards, prepaid cards or cryptocurrency.
title: Payment methods

question: How do I sign up for outage text alerts?
answer: Text REG to 55501 from the mobile number on your account, or turn on alerts at cymbalenergy.example/alerts. You will get updates when an outage is detected, when a crew is assigned and when power is restored.
title: Outage alerts

question: What is Budget Billing?
answer: Budget Billing averages your last 12 months of usage into a level monthly amount so your bill is predictable. The amount is reviewed every six months. Your account must be current to enroll.
title: Budget Billing

question: What should I do if a power line is down?
answer: Stay at least 35 feet away from any downed or sagging line, keep others away, and report it right away at 1-800-555-0142. Always assume a downed line is energized.
title: Downed lines

question: Can I get a paper bill instead of a paperless bill?
answer: Yes. Change your bill delivery preference at cymbalenergy.example/account under Billing Preferences. Paperless customers receive an email when each bill is ready.
title: Bill delivery

question: How do I read my electric meter?
answer: Most Cymbal Energy meters are smart meters that report usage automatically. The display cycles through several readings; the number labeled kWh is your total usage.
title: Meters

question: Why is my bill higher than last month?
answer: Bills are usually higher in summer and winter because heating and cooling use the most energy. Compare your kWh usage to the same month last year on your bill, and check whether the billing period was longer than usual.
title: High bills

question: Do you offer help paying my bill?
answer: Yes. Customers who are struggling can apply for LIHEAP through their county community action agency, apply to the Cymbal Cares fund, or ask about a payment arrangement.
title: Bill assistance

question: How can I trim trees near power lines?
answer: Never trim trees near power lines yourself. Request a free safety trim at cymbalenergy.example/trees and a qualified line-clearance crew will schedule a visit.
title: Tree trimming

question: Where are your offices located?
answer: Customer offices are at 3300 Market Street in Pascagoula and 1010 Government Street in Ocean Springs, open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM.
title: Office locations

question: How do I sign up for the Medical Priority Registry?
answer: Download the Medical Priority Registry form at cymbalenergy.example/medical, have your physician complete it, and return it by mail or email. You will receive outage alerts and welfare checks during extended outages.
title: Medical Priority Registry

question: Can I choose my bill due date?
answer: Yes. Residential customers can move their due date once every 12 months to any day between the 1st and the 28th at cymbalenergy.example/account.
title: Due date
